# EdgeForm

> Edge-native micro-site engine. One JSON config → multi-page site with 7 themes, 13 block types, multi-step forms, i18n, multi-site, deployed on Cloudflare's free tier.

This file is for LLMs/agents navigating the codebase. Spec: https://llmstxt.org/.
For a human introduction, see [README.md](README.md) ([中文](README_CN.md)).

## What this repo is

A monorepo with a single deployable Astro app and a shared types package. The
whole product is one Cloudflare Workers deployment that serves the rendered
sites, the admin console, and the API endpoints.

## Architecture in one paragraph

A site is a JSON document (`SiteConfig`) stored in Cloudflare KV. Each config
has `pages[]`, each page has `blocks[]`, each block has a `type` matched
against a registered renderer. The `SiteEngine` (Astro component) loads the
config, picks a theme from `themeRegistry`, and dispatches each block to the
theme's renderer. Themes are pluggable folders; adding one requires no engine
changes. Form submissions and waitlist signups land in Cloudflare D1; webhook
delivery is fired via `ctx.waitUntil` so the worker doesn't terminate before
the request lands.

## Project layout

```
apps/web/                     Astro SSR app (the entire product)
├── src/
│   ├── pages/
│   │   ├── index.astro       Main site renderer (KV key: site:config)
│   │   ├── admin.astro       Admin console (prerendered, fully client-side)
│   │   ├── llms.txt.ts       (none — root llms.txt is a static file in public/)
│   │   ├── s/[id].astro      Sub-site renderer (KV key: site:{id})
│   │   ├── s/[id]/llms.txt.ts   Per-sub-site GEO surface
│   │   └── api/
│   │       ├── submit.ts            POST — multi-field form submission
│   │       ├── waitlist/index.ts    POST — waitlist email signup
│   │       ├── waitlist/count.ts    GET  — public waitlist count
│   │       ├── img/[id].ts          GET  — serve uploaded image
│   │       └── admin/
│   │           ├── login.ts         POST — auth
│   │           ├── password.ts      POST — change password
│   │           ├── config.ts        GET/PUT/DELETE — site config
│   │           ├── stats.ts         GET  — dashboard stats
│   │           ├── submissions.ts   GET  — paginated submissions list
│   │           ├── waitlist.ts      GET  — paginated waitlist list
│   │           ├── export.ts        GET  — CSV export
│   │           ├── templates.ts     GET  — list/load built-in templates
│   │           ├── translate.ts     POST — batch translate via provider
│   │           ├── upload.ts        POST — upload image to KV
│   │           └── webhook-test.ts  POST — send test payload
│   ├── components/
│   │   └── renderer/
│   │       └── SiteEngine.astro    Core block dispatch engine + runtime JS
│   ├── themes/
│   │   ├── registry.ts             Theme registration (add new themes here)
│   │   ├── types.ts                ThemeDefinition interface
│   │   ├── shared-renderers.ts     Block HTML generators reused across themes
│   │   ├── shared-blocks.css       Shared block CSS (form grid, FAQ, pricing…)
│   │   ├── glass/                  Frosted glass, dark, warm orange
│   │   ├── terminal/               Phosphor-green CRT terminal
│   │   ├── brutal/                 Anti-design, thick borders, loud accent
│   │   ├── minimal/                Swiss design, ultra-clean
│   │   ├── retro/                  Vintage CRT scanlines
│   │   ├── light/                  Clean SaaS, blue accent
│   │   └── soft/                   Warm Notion-inspired, terracotta accent
│   ├── lib/
│   │   ├── icons.ts                Unified Lucide SVG icon set
│   │   ├── i18n-extract.ts         Extract translatable strings from a config
│   │   ├── translate.ts            Multi-provider translation dispatch
│   │   └── admin-auth.ts           Token validation
│   ├── layouts/
│   │   └── Base.astro              <head> with SEO + llms.txt link
│   └── schemas/
│       ├── waitlist.json           Default fallback config (the showcase site)
│       └── templates/*.json        8 starter templates
├── public/
│   ├── favicon.svg
│   └── llms.txt                    GEO surface for the EdgeForm tool itself
├── migrations/
│   ├── 0001_init.sql
│   ├── 0002_add_site_id.sql
│   └── 0003_migrate_waitlist.sql
├── scripts/
│   ├── deploy.sh                   wrangler deploy + first-run provisioning
│   └── cli.ts                      Local CLI: init, add-block, push, pull, translate, deploy
├── tests/cli.test.ts               vitest tests for CLI
└── wrangler.toml                   Cloudflare bindings (D1, KV, AI)

packages/shared/src/types.ts        Block, SiteConfig, ThemeDefinition types

docs/                               Architecture notes
```

## Adding a new block type

1. Define the block shape in `packages/shared/src/types.ts`.
2. Add a default block factory in `apps/web/src/pages/admin.astro`'s `getDefaultBlock`.
3. Add an icon entry in `apps/web/src/lib/icons.ts` and reference it in admin's `BLOCK_DEFS`.
4. Add an extraction case in `apps/web/src/lib/i18n-extract.ts` if it carries translatable text.
5. For each theme that needs custom styling, render the block in `themes/<name>/index.ts`. Most blocks delegate to `shared-renderers.ts`.
6. Add CSS in `themes/shared-blocks.css` (cross-theme) or `themes/<name>/style.css` (theme-specific).
7. Optionally surface its content in `apps/web/src/pages/s/[id]/llms.txt.ts` so LLMs can index it.

## Adding a new theme

1. Create `apps/web/src/themes/<name>/index.ts` exporting a `ThemeDefinition`.
2. Create `apps/web/src/themes/<name>/style.css` with `.ef-t-<name>` scoped rules.
3. Register in `apps/web/src/themes/registry.ts`.
4. Reference theme accent colors as `var(--accent, <fallback>)` and gradients as
   `var(--accent-dark, <fallback>)` so brand color overrides flow through.

## Brand accent token system

Brand color is the single source of truth. `SiteEngine.astro` derives a token
set from `theme.primaryColor`:

- `--accent` — full color
- `--accent-dark` (18% darker), `--accent-deep` (40% darker), `--accent-light` (18% lighter) — solid shades
- `--accent-soft` (10% alpha), `--accent-glow` (40% alpha) — translucent shades
- `--accent-rgb` — comma-separated R, G, B for use inside `rgba(var(--accent-rgb), <alpha>)`

Themes consume these via `var(--token, <fallback-literal>)` so a fresh site
without a brand color set looks identical to before.

## Navigation modes

Two modes only:

- `fullpage` — snap one-page-per-scroll. SiteEngine attaches wheel/touch
  handlers and translates the `.ef-pages` wrapper.
- `scroll` — natural browser scroll. Pages stack at content height.

Legacy `none` configs migrate to `scroll` + `showPageDots:false`.

## Multi-site

A single deployment hosts unlimited sub-sites:
- KV key `site:config` → main site at `/`
- KV key `site:{id}` → sub-site at `/s/{id}`

All admin endpoints accept `?siteId=<id>` (or `body.siteId`); when absent they
default to the main site. Submissions, waitlist entries, and webhooks are all
scoped per-site.

## Webhook delivery

Form submissions and waitlist signups fire a webhook if `siteConfig.webhook.url`
is set. Inside Cloudflare Workers, the fetch is wrapped in
`ctx.waitUntil(...)` (accessed via `locals.cfContext` on Astro v6) so the
worker stays alive until the request completes; otherwise the response would
return and cancel the unawaited fetch.

## Translation

`apps/web/src/lib/translate.ts` dispatches to one of 12 providers. `auto`
sourceLang is supported via provider-specific tactics (omit the `from` param,
or instruct the AI prompt to detect). New providers should be added to
`translateTexts`'s switch in that file.

## Local development

```bash
npm install
cd apps/web
echo "ADMIN_PASSWORD=your-secret" > .dev.vars
npx wrangler d1 execute edgeform-db --local --file=migrations/0001_init.sql
npx wrangler d1 execute edgeform-db --local --file=migrations/0002_add_site_id.sql
npx wrangler d1 execute edgeform-db --local --file=migrations/0003_migrate_waitlist.sql
npx astro dev --port 4321
```

## Deploy

`cd apps/web && npm run deploy` runs `astro build && wrangler deploy`.
First-run provisioning (D1 + KV) is in `scripts/deploy.sh`.

## CLI

`apps/web/scripts/cli.ts` covers the same surface as the admin console:
`init`, `add-page`, `add-block`, `set/get`, `webhook`, `sites`, `templates`,
`use-template`, `translate`, `push`, `pull`, `preview`, `deploy`. All
remote-targeting commands accept `--site <id>` for sub-sites.
